description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Marketplace' within the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages listing, installing, and uninstalling marketplace extensions, handling user permissions, dynamically loading extension components, and rendering views.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions in the OpenCart admin panel. Handles listing available extensions, installation, and uninstallation processes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of marketplace extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of marketplace extensions, including available and installed ones.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a marketplace extension, including permission checks, file existence, and registering extension components.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the removal of a marketplace extension, including permission checks and cleanup steps.
